class.name: InventoryNetworkGateway
class.description: Server/game-owned transport-neutral authenticated inventory ingress and grant-scoped egress. This node owns no MultiplayerPeer or RPC endpoint; the game supplies the trusted peer context. InventoryAuthority command bytes are raw protocol bytes, not RPC messages. Packet identity and observer visibility are never trusted. Fresh logical session ids strictly increase within an authority epoch; reconnect reuses the same id and exact actor/authority epoch with a strictly higher connection epoch and may migrate to a different peer while preserving bounded session state. A higher authority epoch starts a fresh session-id domain only after all live sessions are gone. SessionHello attempts share the command-ingress token bucket with command bytes.

members.member: Positive tick rate used by gateway rate windows.

method.name: accept_session_hello
method.description: Admits exact SessionHello bytes for the trusted peer/session/connection tuple. The attempt consumes the shared authenticated command-ingress token bucket before hello readiness, size/decode, or compatibility; malformed and oversized attempts consume budget too.

method.name: admit_session_hello
method.description: Alias for accept_session_hello().

method.name: begin_session
method.description: Binds an authenticated session. Fresh logical session ids must strictly increase within an authority epoch. A reconnect reuses the same id and exact actor/authority epoch with a strictly higher connection epoch, may use a different peer, and preserves grants, replay/sequence state, and both rate buckets; stale old-peer/old-epoch traffic is rejected. Command permissions default to deny.

method.name: clear_sessions
method.description: Clears all bounded authenticated session, grant, and replay state.

method.name: configure
method.description: Atomically configures the positive authority epoch and tick rate.

method.name: delta_bytes
method.description: Returns grant-scoped trusted server egress bytes. Completed exact SessionHello admission for the current epochs is required; this is trusted server output, not an RPC entry point. Recipient-filtered OWNER DeltaBatch bytes always clear source_command_id to 0; the authority-global id remains only in the server-local raw authority batch so it cannot correlate other touched inventories or principals.

method.name: delta_result
method.description: Returns grant-scoped trusted server egress result data. Completed exact SessionHello admission for the current epochs is required. Recipient-filtered OWNER DeltaBatch results always set source_command_id to 0; the authority-global id remains only in the server-local raw authority batch so it cannot correlate other touched inventories or principals.

method.name: drop_session
method.description: Ends one authenticated session by session id.

method.name: end_session
method.description: Ends the authenticated session bound to a trusted peer.

method.name: get_command_allowlist
method.description: Returns the default-deny command-class mask for a session.

method.name: get_inventory_authority_path
method.description: Alias for get_authority_path().

method.name: get_replication_visibility
method.description: Returns the stored grant visibility; packet content cannot select it.

method.name: get_world_policy_callback
method.description: Alias for get_world_policy().

method.name: grant_command_inventory
method.description: Grants command access to one exact inventory; this is separate from replication.

method.name: grant_inventory
method.description: Alias for the command-inventory grant.

method.name: grant_observer_replication
method.description: Grants observer or redacted recipient-safe replication.

method.name: grant_owner_replication
method.description: Grants canonical owner replication, separate from command access.

method.name: grant_replication
method.description: Stores an exact owner, observer, or redacted replication scope.

method.name: has_inventory_grant
method.description: Tests command access only.

method.name: has_replication_grant
method.description: Tests replication access only.

method.name: replay_entry_count
method.description: Returns the bounded exact-byte replay-entry count.

method.name: resync_bytes
method.description: Returns a trusted server response to an authenticated owner or observer resync request. Completed exact SessionHello admission for the current epochs is required; observer visibility comes from the stored grant.

method.name: resync_result
method.description: Admits an authenticated resync request only after completed exact SessionHello admission for the current epochs; observer visibility comes from the stored grant.

method.name: revoke_command_inventory
method.description: Revokes command access to one exact inventory.

method.name: revoke_inventory
method.description: Alias for the command-inventory revoke.

method.name: revoke_replication
method.description: Removes the stored replication grant.

method.name: session_ready
method.description: Returns true only after exact hello admission for the current epochs.

method.name: set_authority_epoch
method.description: Sets a positive immutable authority generation.

method.name: set_authority_path
method.description: Sets the path to the server-role InventoryAuthority.

method.name: set_command_allowlist
method.description: Sets the default-deny remote command-class mask.

method.name: set_inventory_authority_path
method.description: Alias for set_authority_path().

method.name: set_tick_rate
method.description: Sets a positive bounded tick rate.

method.name: set_world_policy
method.description: Sets the mandatory game-owned world-policy callback. This Callable is trusted server code and must be pure with respect to InventoryAuthority during evaluation: it must not submit typed or raw commands, perform lifecycle, reservation, discovery, or other authority mutations, or perform external side effects. Gateway recursion is blocked, but arbitrary callback side effects cannot generally be rolled back.

method.name: set_world_policy_callback
method.description: Alias for set_world_policy(); the installed trusted server callback must remain pure with respect to InventoryAuthority and external side effects.

method.name: snapshot_bytes
method.description: Returns grant-scoped trusted server egress bytes. Completed exact SessionHello admission for the current epochs is required; this is trusted server output, not an RPC entry point.

method.name: snapshot_result
method.description: Returns grant-scoped trusted server egress result data. Completed exact SessionHello admission for the current epochs is required.

method.name: submit_command
method.description: Bytes-first alias for submit_command_bytes(); packet identity is not trusted.

method.name: submit_command_bytes
method.description: Admits an authenticated raw command envelope. Client-local command id and actor echo are canonicalized by the server; exact accepted replays return a normalized no-event/no-delta receipt. One-shot events, deltas, and side-effect payloads are never exposed; detailed IDs/revisions are retained only when OWNER replication covers every touched inventory. The custom executor is synchronous/immediate; a queued result must not enqueue work or perform any side effects and is rejected because no authoritative reply can be produced.

method.name: submit_remote_command
method.description: Alias for submit_command_bytes().

method.name: tracked_session_count
method.description: Returns the bounded live-session count.

constants.constant: Combined Godot-façade owner plus observer/redacted replication entries per session; the engine-free observer grant cap remains 64.
